name: Shortsword

name: Dagger
description: A small blade for close work or throwing.

name: Greataxe

name: Handaxe
description: A compact axe usable in melee or as a thrown weapon.

name: Mace
description: A blunt weapon favored by practical divine types.

name: Quarterstaff
description: A sturdy staff useful for walking, fighting, and looking scholarly.

description: Medium armor made of overlapping plates. Protective, not exactly whisper-quiet.

name: Chain Mail
description: Heavy linked armor for people who expect trouble to be enthusiastic.

name: Longsword +1
description: A finely enchanted blade that improves both accuracy and damage.

name: Entertainer's Pack
description: Gear for performance and travel.

name: Priest's Pack
description: Supplies for religious travel and rites.

name: Scholar's Pack
description: Writing and research supplies for people who voluntarily enter libraries.
